annotations.title: FDA drug label extract: renal, hepatic, boxed warning

description: AI extraction from the FDA drug label (openFDA SPL) for an NDC, RxCUI or drug name: boxed warning, indications, dosage forms, renal and hepatic dose adjustment, contraindications, pregnancy and lactation, drug interactions, storage. Per section: short summary and points with verbatim label quotes checked in code, plus SPL set ID, version, effective date and DailyMed link. Generated by Anthropic Claude; summarizes FDA labeling, not medical advice. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

drug.description: Generic or brand drug name only, e.g. Eliquis, metformin, amoxicillin clavulanate. Inputs with patient details (age, weight, kidney values, my, patient) are rejected.

ndc.description: NDC in any FDA layout: 10-digit dashed (4-4-2, 5-3-2, 5-4-1), 11-digit (5-4-2) or undashed. Give exactly one of ndc, rxcui or drug.

rxcui.description: RxNorm RxCUI. Product-level concepts (SCD, SBD, packs) match labels that list them; ingredient and brand concepts use the drug-name label selection.

sections.description: Comma-separated sections (default all): boxed_warning, indications, dosage_forms, renal_adjustment, hepatic_adjustment, contraindications, pregnancy_lactation, interactions_summary, storage.
